name: Wolf
group: Animals > Mammals > Wild animals on land > Eats only meat

features.claim: A wolf is slender and powerfully built.
features.quote: It is slender and powerfully built, with an extensive, low-hanging rib cage, a sloping back, and a heavily muscled neck.

features.claim: A wolf has a large, heavy head with a wide forehead, powerful jaws and a long, blunt muzzle.
features.quote: The wolf's head is large and heavy, with a wide forehead, powerful jaws, and a long, blunt muzzle.

features.claim: A wolf has small, wide-set eyes and small pointed ears.
features.quote: It has small, wide-set eyes and small pointed ears.

features.claim: A wolf's legs are a little longer than those of other canids.
features.quote: The wolf's legs are moderately longer than those of other canids, which enables the animal to move swiftly and through deep snow, though shorter-legged ecomorphs are found in some wolf populations.

features.claim: A wolf's coat is mottled grey, but can range from white to brown to black.
features.quote: Wolves are generally mottled grey, but can vary from white to brown to black.

features.claim: A wolf's coat has grey, white, brown and black hairs.
features.quote: Their coats typically have grey, white, brown and black hairs.

features.claim: A wolf's fur is usually mottled white, brown, grey and black.
features.quote: The wolf's fur is usually mottled white, brown, grey, and black, although subspecies in the Arctic region may be nearly all white.

features.claim: A wolf's eyes are yellow, light brown or green.
features.quote: The eyes are yellow, light brown, or green.

features.claim: A wolf has a thick, fluffy winter coat.
features.quote: The wolf has a thick and fluffy winter coat, with the guard hairs being longer and rougher than the undercoat.

quote_not_in_the_page.claim: A wolf has a long muzzle, short upright ears, long legs and a long bushy tail.
quote_not_in_the_page.quote: The wolf has a long muzzle, short upright ears, long legs, and a long bushy tail.

quote_not_in_the_page.claim: A wolf's fur has two layers, a dirt-resistant top layer and a water-resistant under-layer.
quote_not_in_the_page.quote: Wolves have fur made up of two layers.

quote_not_in_the_page.claim: A wolf's underparts and legs are usually creamy-gray.
quote_not_in_the_page.quote: The underparts and legs are usually creamy-gray.
